Data SheetAcoustic Timber™  Raft
Acoustic Timber™  Raft is a modular acoustic baffle system designed 
to communicate with interior spaces via an adjustable channel and 
clip system—giving you complete control over the height, spacing, 
and placement of each individual component. Lightweight yet  
solid in appearance, Acoustic Timber Raft is made from 100% 
polyester fibre. Acoustic Timber Raft is designed to be ‘tuned’ to 
spaces, offering tailored acoustic absorption across a wide range  
of frequencies.
Suitable for use as acoustic and decorative treatments in non-contact areas.  
For applications where contact is likely to occur, Autex Acoustics recommends our 
standard Frontier Raft range. If you have any concerns about the install location, please 
contact your specification manager.
